name: TVQA
intro: TVQA是一个基于6部电视剧的视频问答基准，包含21793个带字幕的60至90秒片段和152545道具有时间定位标注的五选一复合问题。
org: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
eval_feature: 视频与字幕联合理解, 时间定位
eval_feature_en: Joint video-dialogue understanding and temporal localization
intro_en: TVQA is a video QA benchmark built from six television shows, containing 21,793 subtitle-aligned 60- to 90-second clips and 152,545 five-way compositional questions with temporal localization annotations.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with TVQA EMNLP 2018 paper Sections 3 and 5 at ACL Anthology. TVQA begins with 925 episodes from six long-running television shows in three genres, totaling 461 hours. Episodes are segmented into 60- or 90-second clips and boundaries are shifted so subtitle sentences are not split. Subtitles are aligned with transcripts to add speaker names. Amazon Mechanical Turk workers see each clip with named subtitles and write seven free-form compositional questions using when, before, or after grounding cues. For every question they mark exact START and END timestamps and provide one correct answer plus four distractors. An online checker enforces the two-part question form; collection proceeds in batches of 500 videos, and three submitted QA pairs per worker are sampled from every batch to check questions, answers, and timestamps. The released dataset contains 152,545 five-way QA pairs over 21,793 clips. Evaluation compares full-clip and ground-truth localized-clip settings, combines video and subtitle evidence, predicts one of five answers, and reports accuracy.
